title: Scanning Electron Microscopy Image Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
t: Scanning Electron Microscopy Image Analysis Tool — Overview and definition
description: Quantifies microstructural features from SEM images.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Quantifies microstructural features from SEM images. An SEM analysis tool segments grains, particles, fibers, and pores from electron micrographs, correcting for drift and charging artifacts. Real implementations use Fiji/ImageJ, MIPAR, and vendor software. It reports size distributions, volume fractions, and anisotropy with scale calibration.

title: Scanning Electron Microscopy Image Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
t: Scanning Electron Microscopy Image Analysis Tool — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Quantifies microstructural features from SEM images.
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Scanning Electron Microscopy Image Analysis Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Grain and particle segmentation). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Grain and particle segmentation and Porosity and phase-fraction measurement. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Materials microstructure image analyzer) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
